name: com.microtube.hexr
description:
HexR haptic glove integration for Unity: hand-tracking-driven finger/palm haptics, grab detection, and preset effects, built on top of the HaptGlove BLE/haptics layer.

Runs on either OpenXR or the Meta Interaction SDK -- neither is a hard dependency. Use HexR > HexR Tools > Project Setup to install whichever backend this project targets, then HexR > Create HexR Rig to add a rig.

samples.description: Props and scripts from the HexR tutorials: a grabbable torch, a squeezable heart driving SpecialHaptics, a togglable lightbulb, a colour-shifting ball, and the connect/disconnect and grab/drop audio. Backend-agnostic -- works on OpenXR and Meta OVR alike.
